name: better-offer-holds-the-price
description: B makes a live offer of 19,500 within the limits. A keeps offering 18,500. Kritva never counters A below 19,500, and if it mentions the other offer it cites no more than 19,500 and nothing about B.

steps.say: Hi, I can offer 19,500 for the bed and pick it up myself.
Hi, would you take 18,500 for the bed?
18,500 is really what I can do.
Come on, 18,500, I can collect today.
